title: SensorEvent
description: A generic derived sensor event from any connected device. Phase 1 skeleton — to be refined per device.

device_id.description: Stable identifier for the emitting device (e.g. 'watch-wrd6100', 'rb3-vision', 'arduino-unoq').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event.

value.description: Numeric value of the derived signal.
